gp = GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=kernel, n_restarts_optimizer=30, random_state=42, normalize_y=True)
gp.fit(X, y)
print("GP kernel:", gp.kernel_)
print("Noise std:", np.sqrt(gp.kernel_.k2.noise_level) * np.std(y))

# Optimize GP mean over Set A (Iter 14's 9 ingredients) and Set B (Iter 13's 9 ingredients) and Set C (hybrid)
